snippet.title: Sonic 06 Legacy of Solaris Sonic's Story Part 1
snippet.description: Now to the main event, the main hedgehogs stories. Sonic's story is relatively unchanged from how it is in retail. However I do allow earlier access to the gems. I tackle Wave Ocean to the Silver Boss Fight here. I generally skip cutscenes as they aren't the focus here, the gameplay is.
